name: MODO BASS 2
help: MODO BASS 2 defaults: Finger/Pick/Slap keyswitches, Ghost mode, CC9 muting. In Natural feel also legato slides (CC65), hammer-ons (KS 24), ghost notes in busy grooves, stop-on-detach (KS 32), down-strokes (KS 13) and continuous muting; slides and hammer-ons come more often as Energy and Fills rise. Applies on Bass. Natural also sends vibrato (CC1), let ring (CC64), falls (pitch wheel), a left-hand position per section (CC4, frets 0-24 spread over 0-127) and the pluck position (CC3), as on MODO's Control page. A fall bends by MODO's Slide Range (Control page, 2 by default): set it to 4 for a deeper fall.
